Five to keep

,

If a pattern only shines in the case study and never in the analytics, it was decoration. We keep the ones that move a number.

Short transitions of 200 to 300 milliseconds beat long reveals every time. On the Hexa Labs launch page, motion that guided visitors from the film to the pre-order form helped the page convert three times better than the old one.
